Group Preparation for Imputation

Source: R/group_imp.R
prep_groups.Rd

Normalize and validate a grouping specification for use with group_imp().

Usage

prep_groups(
  obj_cn,
  group,
  subset = NULL,
  min_group_size = 0,
  allow_unmapped = FALSE,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

obj_cn

Character. The column names of the data matrix, usually colnames(obj).

group

A data frame or a character scalar. The feature groups, in one of these forms:

  • A character scalar naming a supported Illumina platform, such as "EPICv2". This needs the slideimp.extra package.

  • A long-format data frame with columns group and feature.

  • A list-column data frame with a feature list-column. Optional list-columns are aux, for auxiliary feature names, and parameters, for group-specific parameter lists.

subset

Optional character vector. The features to impute, by name, or NULL for every grouped feature. A group's other features become its auxiliary columns, and a group left with no feature is dropped with a message.

min_group_size

Integer. Minimum number of columns per group, features and auxiliary columns together. Groups smaller than this are padded with columns sampled at random from the other grouped columns in obj_cn. If 0, no padding is performed.

allow_unmapped

Logical. If FALSE, every column in colnames(obj) must appear in group. If TRUE, columns with no group assignment are left untouched and are not used as auxiliary columns.

seed

Integer, numeric, or NULL. Random seed used when padding small groups.

Value

A data frame of class slideimp_tbl containing:

  • group: original group labels, if provided, or sequential group labels.

  • feature: a list-column of character vectors containing feature names.

  • aux: a list-column of character vectors containing auxiliary names.

  • parameters: a list-column of per-group configuration lists.

Details

prep_groups() converts a long-format or list-column group to a slideimp_tbl, and pads small groups when min_group_size is above 0.

Let \(A\) be obj_cn and \(B\) be the union of all feature and auxiliary names in group. When allow_unmapped = FALSE, prep_groups() requires \(A \subseteq B\): every name in obj_cn must appear in group.

Names in \(B\) but not in \(A\), such as probes dropped in quality control, are removed from each group. Groups left with no features are dropped with a message.

See also

group_imp() to impute with the prepared groups.

Examples

sim <- sim_mat(n = 10, p = 20)
prepped <- prep_groups(colnames(sim$input), sim$col_group)
prepped
#> # slideimp table: 2 x 4
#>   group          feature             aux parameters
#>  group1 <character [12]> <character [0]> <list [0]>
#>  group2  <character [8]> <character [0]> <list [0]>
